evals.name: small-batch-3
evals.prompt: fetch the 3 most recent free Dan Koe articles from his newsletter archive at letters.thedankoe.com/archive?sort=new and save them as markdown into 00-Raw/DanKoe/原文/. Skip any articles that are already in that folder, and skip any that are paywalled (look for Subscribe to keep reading / Already a paid subscriber etc in the article body). Use the same structured frontmatter format the existing files there use: a # Title H1 followed by Source/Published/Author bold key/value lines, then a horizontal rule, then the body. Name files YYYYMMDD-{slug}-原文.md using the article's publish date.
evals.expected_output: 3 new markdown files saved to 00-Raw/DanKoe/原文/ matching the 20250506/20250802 format (Source/Published/Author bold lines, body below the horizontal rule). Files NOT saved: paywalled articles, already-existing articles. Brief summary at end reporting fetched / skipped-already / skipped-paywall counts.

evals.name: idempotent-rerun
evals.prompt: re-run your Dan Koe fetcher one more time with the same defaults (10 newest free articles from letters.thedankoe.com/archive?sort=new into 00-Raw/DanKoe/原文/). It should dedup against what is already in the folder. Use the same structured frontmatter as before.
evals.expected_output: Either (a) some new files if there are unseen articles beyond what was saved last run, or (b) a clean report saying all candidates were already in 原文/ and nothing was saved. Should NOT touch or overwrite existing files.
